### Traps measured 2026-09-19, so they are not re-derived

- **A Cloud Run service pinned to a NAMED revision makes every deploy a silent no-op.** Fixed on `plan-review`, still live on `smart-files` (G-176). Do not generalise the fix: releasing to latest worked only because it landed on a revision already carrying the intended commit.
- **A traffic shift is refused without a lease at `_catalog/leases/<service>.json`.** That refusal is the control working: write the lease, shift, read the serving revision BY FIELD, probe, delete the lease.
- **The tracker reads the LEADING word of a status cell.** Appending the status reads as OPEN; replace the leading token and push the old one into `HISTORY:`.
- **A pinned sha256 may be line-ending dependent** (G-169's `588F2B82...` is the CRLF form of `943A621B...`).
- **`OPS-17` holds real em dashes**, which PowerShell 5.1 renders as mojibake, so a shell-rendered substring will not match in an edit.

## Standing rules

- Product repos: branch, PR, merge on green. May merge own branches.
- Does not write property, markets, or substrate repos. Request changes from the owning seat.
- Deploys are planner-owned. Merged is not live. Grade on the deployed surface, never on a merged PR.
